verses.english: As a whole forest becomes fragrant by the existence of a single tree with sweet-smelling blossoms in it, so a family becomes famous by the birth of a virtuous son.

verses.text: अध्याय 3, सूत्र 14
verses.hindi: अध्याय 3, श्लोक 14 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: As a single withered tree, if set aflame, causes a whole forest to burn, so does a rascal son destroy a whole family.

verses.text: अध्याय 3, सूत्र 15
verses.hindi: अध्याय 3, श्लोक 15 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: As night looks delightful when the moon shines, so is a family gladdened by even one learned and virtuous son.

verses.text: अध्याय 3, सूत्र 16
verses.hindi: अध्याय 3, श्लोक 16 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: What is the use of having many sons if they cause grief and vexation? It is better to have only one son from whom the whole family can derive support and peacefulness.

verses.text: अध्याय 3, सूत्र 17
verses.hindi: अध्याय 3, श्लोक 17 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Fondle a son until he is five years of age, and use the stick for another ten years, but when he has attained his sixteenth year treat him as a friend.

verses.text: अध्याय 3, सूत्र 18
verses.hindi: अध्याय 3, श्लोक 18 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: He who runs away from a fearful calamity, a foreign invasion, a terrible famine, and the companionship of wicked men is safe.

verses.text: अध्याय 3, सूत्र 20
verses.hindi: अध्याय 3, श्लोक 20 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Lakshmi, the Goddess of wealth, comes of Her own accord where fools are not respected, grain is well stored up, and the husband and wife do not quarrel.

verses.text: अध्याय 4, सूत्र 1
verses.hindi: अध्याय 4, श्लोक 1 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: These five: the life-span, the type of work, wealth, learning and the time of one's death are determined while one is in the womb.

verses.text: अध्याय 4, सूत्र 2
verses.hindi: अध्याय 4, श्लोक 2 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Offspring, friends and relatives flee from a devotee of the Lord: yet those who follow him bring merit to their families through their devotion.

verses.text: अध्याय 4, सूत्र 3
verses.hindi: अध्याय 4, श्लोक 3 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Fish, tortoises, and birds bring up their young by means of sight, attention and touch; so do saintly men afford protection to their associates by the same means.

verses.text: अध्याय 4, सूत्र 4
verses.hindi: अध्याय 4, श्लोक 4 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: As long as your body is healthy and under control and death is distant, try to save your soul; when death is immanent what can you do?

verses.text: अध्याय 4, सूत्र 5
verses.hindi: अध्याय 4, श्लोक 5 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Learning is like a cow of desire. It, like her, yields in all seasons. Like a mother, it feeds you on your journey. Therefore learning is a hidden treasure.

verses.text: अध्याय 4, सूत्र 6
verses.hindi: अध्याय 4, श्लोक 6 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: A single son endowed with good qualities is far better than a hundred devoid of them. For the moon, though one, dispels the darkness, which the stars, though numerous, can not.

verses.text: अध्याय 4, सूत्र 7
verses.hindi: अध्याय 4, श्लोक 7 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: A still-born son as superior to a foolish son endowed with a long life. The first causes grief for but a moment while the latter like a blazing fire consumes his parents in grief for life.

verses.text: अध्याय 4, सूत्र 8
verses.hindi: अध्याय 4, श्लोक 8 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Residing in a small village devoid of proper living facilities, serving a person born of a low family, unwholesome food, a frowning wife, a foolish son, and a widowed daughter burn the body without fire.

verses.text: अध्याय 4, सूत्र 9
verses.hindi: अध्याय 4, श्लोक 9 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: What good is a cow that neither gives milk nor conceives? Similarly, what is the value of the birth of a son if he becomes neither learned nor a pure devotee of the Lord?

verses.text: अध्याय 4, सूत्र 10
verses.hindi: अध्याय 4, श्लोक 10 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: When one is consumed by the sorrows of life, three things give him relief: offspring, a wife, and the company of the Lord's devotees.

verses.text: अध्याय 4, सूत्र 11
verses.hindi: अध्याय 4, श्लोक 11 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Kings speak for once, men of learning once, and the daughter is given in marriage once. All these things happen once and only once.

verses.text: अध्याय 4, सूत्र 12
verses.hindi: अध्याय 4, श्लोक 12 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Religious austerities should be practiced alone, study by two, and singing by three. A journey should be undertaken by four, agriculture by five, and war by many together.

verses.text: अध्याय 4, सूत्र 13
verses.hindi: अध्याय 4, श्लोक 13 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: She is a true wife who is clean (suci), expert, chaste, pleasing to the husband, and truthful.

verses.text: अध्याय 4, सूत्र 14
verses.hindi: अध्याय 4, श्लोक 14 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: The house of a childless person is a void, all directions are void to one who has no relatives, the heart of a fool is also void, but to a poverty stricken man all is void.

verses.text: अध्याय 4, सूत्र 15
verses.hindi: अध्याय 4, श्लोक 15 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Scriptural lessons not put into practice are poison; a meal is poison to him who suffers from indigestion; a social gathering is poison to a poverty stricken person; and a young wife is poison to an aged man.

verses.text: अध्याय 4, सूत्र 16
verses.hindi: अध्याय 4, श्लोक 16 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: That man who is without religion and mercy should be rejected. A guru without spiritual knowledge should be rejected. The wife with an offensive face should be given up, and so should relatives who are without affection.

verses.text: अध्याय 4, सूत्र 17
verses.hindi: अध्याय 4, श्लोक 17 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Constant travel brings old age upon a man; a horse becomes old by being constantly tied up; lack of sexual contact with her husband brings old age upon a woman; and garments become old through being left in the sun.

verses.text: अध्याय 4, सूत्र 18
verses.hindi: अध्याय 4, श्लोक 18 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Consider again and again the following: the right time, the right friends, the right place, the right means of income, the right ways of spending, and from whom you derive your power.

verses.text: अध्याय 4, सूत्र 19
verses.hindi: अध्याय 4, श्लोक 19 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: For the twice-born the fire (Agni) is a representative of God. The Supreme Lord resides in the heart of His devotees. Those of average intelligence (alpa-buddhi or kanista-adhikari) see God only in His srimurti, but those of broad vision see the Supreme Lord everywhere.

verses.text: अध्याय 5, सूत्र 1
verses.hindi: अध्याय 5, श्लोक 1 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Agni is the worshipable person for the twice-born; the brahmana for the other castes; the husband for the wife; and the guest who comes for food at the midday meal for all.

verses.text: अध्याय 5, सूत्र 2
verses.hindi: अध्याय 5, श्लोक 2 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: As gold is tested in four ways by rubbing, cutting, heating and beating - - so a man should be tested by these four things: his renunciation, his conduct, his qualities and his actions.

verses.text: अध्याय 5, सूत्र 3
verses.hindi: अध्याय 5, श्लोक 3 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: A thing may be dreaded as long as it has not overtaken you, but once it has come upon you, try to get rid of it without hesitation.

verses.text: अध्याय 5, सूत्र 4
verses.hindi: अध्याय 5, श्लोक 4 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Though persons be born from the same womb and under the same stars, they do not become alike in disposition as the thousand fruits of the badari tree.

verses.text: अध्याय 5, सूत्र 5
verses.hindi: अध्याय 5, श्लोक 5 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: He whose hands are clean does not like to hold an office; he who desires nothing cares not for bodily decorations; he who is only partially educated cannot speak agreeably; and he who speaks out plainly cannot be a deceiver.

verses.text: अध्याय 5, सूत्र 6
verses.hindi: अध्याय 5, श्लोक 6 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: The learned are envied by the foolish; rich men by the poor; chaste women by adulteresses; and beautiful ladies by ugly ones.

verses.text: अध्याय 5, सूत्र 7
verses.hindi: अध्याय 5, श्लोक 7 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Indolent application ruins study; money is lost when entrusted to others; a farmer who sows his seed sparsely is ruined; and an army is lost for want of a commander.

verses.text: अध्याय 5, सूत्र 8
verses.hindi: अध्याय 5, श्लोक 8 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Learning is retained through putting into practice; family prestige is maintained through good behaviour; a respectable person is recognised by his excellent qualities; and anger is seen in the eyes.

verses.text: अध्याय 5, सूत्र 9
verses.hindi: अध्याय 5, श्लोक 9 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Religion is preserved by wealth; knowledge by diligent practice; a king by conciliatory words; and a home by a dutiful housewife.

verses.text: अध्याय 5, सूत्र 10
verses.hindi: अध्याय 5, श्लोक 10 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Those who blaspheme Vedic wisdom, who ridicule the life style recommended in the satras, and who deride men of peaceful temperament, come to grief unnecessarily.

verses.text: अध्याय 5, सूत्र 11
verses.hindi: अध्याय 5, श्लोक 11 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Charity puts an end to poverty; righteous conduct to misery; discretion to ignorance; and scrutiny to fear.

verses.text: अध्याय 5, सूत्र 12
verses.hindi: अध्याय 5, श्लोक 12 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: There is no disease (so destructive) as lust; no enemy like infatuation; no fire like wrath; and no happiness like spiritual knowledge.

verses.text: अध्याय 5, सूत्र 13
verses.hindi: अध्याय 5, श्लोक 13 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: A man is born alone and dies alone; and he experiences the good and bad consequences of his karma alone; and he goes alone to hell or the Supreme abode.

verses.text: अध्याय 5, सूत्र 14
verses.hindi: अध्याय 5, श्लोक 14 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Heaven is but a straw to him who knows spiritual life (Krsna consciousness); so is life to a valiant man; a woman to him who has subdued his senses; and the universe to him who is without attachment for the world.

verses.text: अध्याय 5, सूत्र 15
verses.hindi: अध्याय 5, श्लोक 15 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Learning is a friend on the journey; a wife in the house; medicine in sickness; and religious merit is the only friend after death.

verses.text: अध्याय 5, सूत्र 16
verses.hindi: अध्याय 5, श्लोक 16 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: There is no water like rainwater; no strength like one's own; no light like that of the eyes; and no wealth more dear than food grain.

verses.text: अध्याय 5, सूत्र 17
verses.hindi: अध्याय 5, श्लोक 17 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: The poor wish for wealth; animals for the faculty of speech; men wish for heaven; and godly persons for liberation.

verses.text: अध्याय 5, सूत्र 18
verses.hindi: अध्याय 5, श्लोक 18 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: The earth is supported by the power of truth; it is the power of truth that makes the sun shine and the winds blow; indeed all things rest upon truth.

verses.text: अध्याय 5, सूत्र 19
verses.hindi: अध्याय 5, श्लोक 19 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: The Goddess of wealth is unsteady (chanchala), and so is the life breath. The duration of life is uncertain, and the place of habitation is uncertain; but in all this inconsistent world religious merit alone is immovable.

verses.text: अध्याय 5, सूत्र 20
verses.hindi: अध्याय 5, श्लोक 20 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Among men the barber is cunning; among birds the crow; among beasts the jackal; and among women, the malin (flower girl).

verses.text: अध्याय 5, सूत्र 21
verses.hindi: अध्याय 5, श्लोक 21 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: These five are your fathers; he who gave you birth, girdled you with sacred thread, teaches you, provides you with food, and protects you from fearful situations.

verses.text: अध्याय 5, सूत्र 22
verses.hindi: अध्याय 5, श्लोक 22 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: These five should be considered as mothers; the king's wife, the preceptor's wife, the friend's wife, your wife's mother, and your own mother.

verses.text: अध्याय 6, सूत्र 1
verses.hindi: अध्याय 6, श्लोक 1 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: By means of hearing one understands dharma, malignity vanishes, knowledge is acquired, and liberation from material bondage is gained.

verses.text: अध्याय 6, सूत्र 2
verses.hindi: अध्याय 6, श्लोक 2 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Among birds the crow is vile; among beasts the dog; the ascetic whose sins is abominable, but he who blasphemes others is the worst chandala.

verses.text: अध्याय 6, सूत्र 3
verses.hindi: अध्याय 6, श्लोक 3 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Brass is polished by ashes; copper is cleaned by tamarind; a woman, by her menses; and a river by its flow.

verses.text: अध्याय 6, सूत्र 4
verses.hindi: अध्याय 6, श्लोक 4 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: The king, the brahmana, and the ascetic yogi who go abroad are respected; but the woman who wanders is utterly ruined.

verses.text: अध्याय 6, सूत्र 5
verses.hindi: अध्याय 6, श्लोक 5 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: He who has wealth has friends. He who is wealthy has relatives. The rich one alone is called a man, and the affluent alone are respected as pandits.

verses.text: अध्याय 6, सूत्र 6
verses.hindi: अध्याय 6, श्लोक 6 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: As is the desire of Providence, so functions one's intellect; one's activities are also controlled by Providence; and by the will of Providence one is surrounded by helpers.

verses.text: अध्याय 6, सूत्र 7
verses.hindi: अध्याय 6, श्लोक 7 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Time perfects all living beings as well as kills them; it alone is awake when all others are asleep. Time is insurmountable.

verses.text: अध्याय 6, सूत्र 8
verses.hindi: अध्याय 6, श्लोक 8 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Those born blind cannot see; similarly blind are those in the grip of lust. Proud men have no perception of evil; and those bent on acquiring riches see no sin in their actions.

verses.text: अध्याय 6, सूत्र 9
verses.hindi: अध्याय 6, श्लोक 9 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: The spirit soul goes through his own course of karma and he himself suffers the good and bad results thereby accrued. By his own actions he entangles himself in samsara, and by his own efforts he extricates himself.

verses.text: अध्याय 6, सूत्र 10
verses.hindi: अध्याय 6, श्लोक 10 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: The king is obliged to accept the sins of his subjects; the purohit (priest) suffers for those of the king; a husband suffers for those of his wife; and the guru suffers for those of his pupils.

verses.text: अध्याय 6, सूत्र 11
verses.hindi: अध्याय 6, श्लोक 11 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: A father who is a chronic debtor, an adulterous mother, a beautiful wife, and an unlearned son are enemies ( in one's own home).

verses.text: अध्याय 6, सूत्र 12
verses.hindi: अध्याय 6, श्लोक 12 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Conciliate () a covetous () man by means of a gift, an obstinate () man with folded hands in salutation, a fool by humouring him, and a learned man by truthful words.

verses.text: अध्याय 6, सूत्र 13
verses.hindi: अध्याय 6, श्लोक 13 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: It is better to be without a kingdom than to rule over a petty one; better to be without a friend than to befriend a rascal; better to be without a disciple than to have a stupid one; and better to be without a wife than to have a bad one.

verses.text: अध्याय 6, सूत्र 14
verses.hindi: अध्याय 6, श्लोक 14 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: How can people be made happy in a petty kingdom? What peace can we expect from a rascal friend? What happiness can we have at home in the company of a bad wife? How can renown be gained by instructing an unworthy disciple?

verses.text: अध्याय 6, सूत्र 15
verses.hindi: अध्याय 6, श्लोक 15 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Learn one thing from a lion; one from a crane; four from a cock; five from a crow; six from a dog; and three from an ass.

verses.text: अध्याय 6, सूत्र 16
verses.hindi: अध्याय 6, श्लोक 16 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: The one excellent thing that can be learned from a lion is that whatever a man intends doing should be done by him with a whole-hearted and strenuous effort.

verses.text: अध्याय 6, सूत्र 17
verses.hindi: अध्याय 6, श्लोक 17 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: The wise man should restrain his senses like the crane and accomplish his purpose with due knowledge of his place, time and ability.

verses.text: अध्याय 6, सूत्र 18
verses.hindi: अध्याय 6, श्लोक 18 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: To wake at the proper time; to take a bold stand and fight; to make a fair division (of property) among relations; and to earn one's own bread by personal exertion are the four excellent things to be learned from a cock.

verses.text: अध्याय 6, सूत्र 19
verses.hindi: अध्याय 6, श्लोक 19 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Union in privacy (with one's wife); boldness; storing away useful items; watchfulness; and not easily trusting others; these five things are to be learned from a crow.

verses.text: अध्याय 6, सूत्र 20
verses.hindi: अध्याय 6, श्लोक 20 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Contentment with little or nothing to eat although one may have a great appetite; to awaken instantly although one may be in a deep slumber; unflinching devotion to the master; and bravery; these six qualities should be learned from the dog.

verses.text: अध्याय 6, सूत्र 21
verses.hindi: अध्याय 6, श्लोक 21 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Although an ass is tired, he continues to carry his burden; he is unmindful of cold and heat; and he is always contented; these three things should be learned from the ass.

verses.text: अध्याय 6, सूत्र 22
verses.hindi: अध्याय 6, श्लोक 22 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: He who shall practice these twenty virtues shall become invincible in all his undertakings.

verses.text: अध्याय 7, सूत्र 1
verses.hindi: अध्याय 7, श्लोक 1 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: A wise man should not reveal his loss of wealth, the vexation of his mind, the misconduct of his own wife, base words spoken by others, and disgrace that has befallen him.

verses.text: अध्याय 7, सूत्र 2
verses.hindi: अध्याय 7, श्लोक 2 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: He who gives up shyness in monetary dealings, in acquiring knowledge, in eating and in business, becomes happy.

verses.text: अध्याय 7, सूत्र 3
verses.hindi: अध्याय 7, श्लोक 3 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: The happiness and peace attained by those satisfied by the nectar of spiritual tranquillity is not attained by greedy persons restlessly moving here and there.

verses.text: अध्याय 7, सूत्र 4
verses.hindi: अध्याय 7, श्लोक 4 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: One should feel satisfied with the following three things; his own wife, food given by Providence and wealth acquired by honest effort; but one should never feel satisfied with the following three; study, chanting the holy names of the Lord (japa) and charity.

verses.text: अध्याय 7, सूत्र 5
verses.hindi: अध्याय 7, श्लोक 5 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Do not pass between two brahmanas, between a brahmana and his sacrificial fire, between a wife and her husband, a master and his servant, and a plough and an ox.

verses.text: अध्याय 7, सूत्र 6
verses.hindi: अध्याय 7, श्लोक 6 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Do not let your foot touch fire, the spiritual master or a brahmana; it must never touch a cow, a virgin, an old person or a child.

verses.text: अध्याय 7, सूत्र 7
verses.hindi: अध्याय 7, श्लोक 7 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Keep one thousand cubits away from an elephant, a hundred from a horse, ten from a horned beast, but keep away from the wicked by leaving the country.

verses.text: अध्याय 7, सूत्र 8
verses.hindi: अध्याय 7, श्लोक 8 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: An elephant is controlled by a goad (ankusha), a horse by a slap of the hand, a horned animal with the show of a stick, and a rascal with a sword.

verses.text: अध्याय 7, सूत्र 9
verses.hindi: अध्याय 7, श्लोक 9 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Brahmanas find satisfaction in a good meal, peacocks in the peal of thunder, a sadhu in seeing the prosperity of others, and the wicked in the misery of others.

verses.text: अध्याय 7, सूत्र 10
verses.hindi: अध्याय 7, श्लोक 10 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Conciliate a strong man by submission, a wicked man by opposition, and the one whose power is equal to yours by politeness or force.

verses.text: अध्याय 7, सूत्र 11
verses.hindi: अध्याय 7, श्लोक 11 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: The power of a king lies in his mighty arms; that of a brahmana in his spiritual knowledge; and that of a woman in her beauty youth and sweet words.

verses.text: अध्याय 7, सूत्र 12
verses.hindi: अध्याय 7, श्लोक 12 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Do not be very upright in your dealings for you would see by going to the forest that straight trees are cut down while crooked ones are left standing.

verses.text: अध्याय 7, सूत्र 13
verses.hindi: अध्याय 7, श्लोक 13 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Swans live wherever there is water, and leave the place where water dries up; let not a man act so -- and come and go as he pleases.

verses.text: अध्याय 7, सूत्र 14
verses.hindi: अध्याय 7, श्लोक 14 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Accumulated wealth is saved by spending just as incoming fresh water is saved by letting out stagnant water.

verses.text: अध्याय 7, सूत्र 15
verses.hindi: अध्याय 7, श्लोक 15 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: He who has wealth has friends and relations; he alone survives and is respected as a man.

verses.text: अध्याय 7, सूत्र 16
verses.hindi: अध्याय 7, श्लोक 16 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: The following four characteristics of the denizens of heaven may be seen in the residents of this earth planet; charity, sweet words, worship of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, and satisfying the needs of brahmanas.

verses.text: अध्याय 7, सूत्र 17
verses.hindi: अध्याय 7, श्लोक 17 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: The following qualities of the denizens of hell may characterise men on earth; extreme wrath, harsh speech, enmity with one's relations, the company with the base, and service to men of low extraction.

verses.text: अध्याय 7, सूत्र 18
verses.hindi: अध्याय 7, श्लोक 18 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: By going to the den of a lion pearls from the head of an elephant may be obtained; but by visiting the hole of a jackal nothing but the tail of a calf or a bit of the hide of an ass may found.

verses.text: अध्याय 7, सूत्र 19
verses.hindi: अध्याय 7, श्लोक 19 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: The life of an uneducated man is as useless as the tail of a dog which neither covers its rear end, nor protects it from the bites of insects.

verses.text: अध्याय 7, सूत्र 20
verses.hindi: अध्याय 7, श्लोक 20 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Purity of speech, of the mind, of the senses, and the of a compassionate heart are needed by one who desires to rise to the divine platform.

verses.text: अध्याय 7, सूत्र 21
verses.hindi: अध्याय 7, श्लोक 21 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: As you seek fragrance in a flower, oil in the sesamum seed, fire in wood, ghee in milk, and jaggery (guda) in sugarcane; so seek the spirit that is in the body by means of discrimination.

verses.text: अध्याय 8, सूत्र 1
verses.hindi: अध्याय 8, श्लोक 1 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Low class men desire wealth; middle class men both wealth and respect; but the noble, honour only; hence honour is the noble man's true wealth.

verses.text: अध्याय 8, सूत्र 2
verses.hindi: अध्याय 8, श्लोक 2 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: The lamp eats up the darkness and therefore it produces lamp black; in the same way according to the nature of our diet (sattva, rajas, or tamas) we produce offspring in similar quality.

verses.text: अध्याय 8, सूत्र 3
verses.hindi: अध्याय 8, श्लोक 3 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: O wise man! Give your wealth only to the worthy and never to others. The water of the sea received by the clouds is always sweet. The rain water enlivens all living beings of the earth both movable (insects, animals, humans, etc.) and immovable (plants, trees, etc.), and then returns to the ocean it value multiplied a million fold.

verses.text: अध्याय 8, सूत्र 4
verses.hindi: अध्याय 8, श्लोक 4 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: The wise who discern the essence of things have declared that the yavana (meat eater) is equal in baseness to a thousand candalas the lowest class), and hence a yavana is the basest of men; indeed there is no one more base.

verses.text: अध्याय 8, सूत्र 5
verses.hindi: अध्याय 8, श्लोक 5 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: After having rubbed oil on the body, after encountering the smoke from a funeral pyre, after sexual intercourse, and after being shaved, one remains a chandala until he bathes.

verses.text: अध्याय 8, सूत्र 6
verses.hindi: अध्याय 8, श्लोक 6 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Water is the medicine for indigestion; it is invigorating when the food that is eaten is well digested; it is like nectar when drunk in the middle of a dinner; and it is like poison when taken at the end of a meal.

verses.text: अध्याय 8, सूत्र 7
verses.hindi: अध्याय 8, श्लोक 7 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Knowledge is lost without putting it into practice; a man is lost due to ignorance; an army is lost without a commander; and a woman is lost without a husband.

verses.text: अध्याय 8, सूत्र 8
verses.hindi: अध्याय 8, श्लोक 8 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: A man who encounters the following three is unfortunate; the death of his wife in his old age, the entrusting of money into the hands of relatives, and depending upon others for food.

verses.text: अध्याय 8, सूत्र 9
verses.hindi: अध्याय 8, श्लोक 9 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Chanting of the Vedas without making ritualistic sacrifices to the Supreme Lord through the medium of Agni, and sacrifices not followed  by bountiful gifts are futile. Perfection can be achieved only through devotion (to the Supreme Lord) for devotion is the basis of all success.

verses.text: अध्याय 8, सूत्र 10
verses.hindi: अध्याय 8, श्लोक 10 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: There is no austerity equal to a balanced mind, and there is no happiness equal to contentment; there is no disease like covetousness, and no virtue like mercy.

verses.text: अध्याय 8, सूत्र 11
verses.hindi: अध्याय 8, श्लोक 11 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Anger is a personification of Yama (the demigod of death); thirst is like the hellish river Vaitarani; knowledge is like a kamadhenu (the cow of plenty); and contentment is like Nandanavana (the garden of Indra).

verses.text: अध्याय 8, सूत्र 12
verses.hindi: अध्याय 8, श्लोक 12 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Moral excellence is an ornament for personal beauty; righteous conduct, for high birth; success for learning; and proper spending for wealth.

verses.text: अध्याय 8, सूत्र 13
verses.hindi: अध्याय 8, श्लोक 13 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Beauty is spoiled by an immoral nature; noble birth by bad conduct; learning, without being perfected; and wealth by not being properly utilised.

verses.text: अध्याय 8, सूत्र 14
verses.hindi: अध्याय 8, श्लोक 14 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Water seeping into the earth is pure; and a devoted wife is pure; the king who is the benefactor of his people is pure; and pure is the brahmana who is contented.

verses.text: अध्याय 8, सूत्र 15
verses.hindi: अध्याय 8, श्लोक 15 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Discontented brahmanas, contented kings, shy prostitutes, and immodest housewives are ruined.

verses.text: अध्याय 8, सूत्र 16
verses.hindi: अध्याय 8, श्लोक 16 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Of what avail is a high birth if a person is destitute of scholarship? A man who is of low extraction is honoured even by the demigods if he is learned.

verses.text: अध्याय 8, सूत्र 17
verses.hindi: अध्याय 8, श्लोक 17 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: A learned man is honoured by the people. A learned man commands respect everywhere for his learning. Indeed, learning is honoured everywhere.

verses.text: अध्याय 8, सूत्र 18
verses.hindi: अध्याय 8, श्लोक 18 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Those who are endowed with beauty and youth and who are born of noble families are worthless if they have no learning. They are just like  the kimshuka blossoms ( flowers of the palasa tree) which, though beautiful, have no fragrance.

verses.text: अध्याय 8, सूत्र 19
verses.hindi: अध्याय 8, श्लोक 19 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: The earth is encumbered with the weight of the flesh-eaters, winebibblers, dolts and blockheads, who are beasts in the form of men.

verses.text: अध्याय 8, सूत्र 20
verses.hindi: अध्याय 8, श्लोक 20 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: There is no enemy like a yajna (sacrifice) which consumes the kingdom when not attended by feeding on a large scale; consumes the priest when the chanting is not done properly; and consumes the yajaman (the responsible person) when the gifts are not made.

verses.text: अध्याय 9, सूत्र 1
verses.hindi: अध्याय 9, श्लोक 1 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: My dear child, if you desire to be free from the cycle of birth and death, then abandon the objects of sense gratification as poison. Drink instead the nectar of forbearance, upright conduct, mercy, cleanliness and truth.

verses.text: अध्याय 9, सूत्र 2
verses.hindi: अध्याय 9, श्लोक 2 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Those base men who speak of the secret faults of others destroy themselves like serpents who stray onto anthills.

verses.text: अध्याय 9, सूत्र 3
verses.hindi: अध्याय 9, श्लोक 3 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Perhaps nobody has advised Lord Brahma, the creator, to impart perfume to gold; fruit to the sugarcane; flowers to the sandalwood tree; wealth to the learned; and long life to the king.

verses.text: अध्याय 9, सूत्र 4
verses.hindi: अध्याय 9, श्लोक 4 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Nectar (amrita) is the best among medicines; eating good food is the best of all types of material happiness; the eye is the chief among all organs; and the head occupies the chief position among all parts of the body.

verses.text: अध्याय 9, सूत्र 5
verses.hindi: अध्याय 9, श्लोक 5 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: No messenger can travel about in the sky and no tidings come from there. The voice of its inhabitants as never heard, nor can any contact be established with them. Therefore the brahmana who predicts the eclipse of the sun and moon which occur in the sky must be considered as a vidwan (man of great learning).

verses.text: अध्याय 9, सूत्र 6
verses.hindi: अध्याय 9, श्लोक 6 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: The student, the servant, the traveller, the hungry person, the frightened man, the treasury guard, and the steward: these seven ought to be awakened if they fall asleep.

verses.text: अध्याय 9, सूत्र 7
verses.hindi: अध्याय 9, श्लोक 7 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: The serpent, the king, the tiger, the stinging wasp, the small child, the dog owned by other people, and the fool: these seven ought not to be awakened from sleep.

verses.text: अध्याय 9, सूत्र 8
verses.hindi: अध्याय 9, श्लोक 8 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Of those who have studied the Vedas for material rewards, and those who accept foodstuffs offered by shudras, what potency have they? They are just like serpents without fangs.

verses.text: अध्याय 9, सूत्र 9
verses.hindi: अध्याय 9, श्लोक 9 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: He who neither rouses fear by his anger, nor confers a favour when he is pleased can neither control nor protect. What can he do?

verses.text: अध्याय 9, सूत्र 10
verses.hindi: अध्याय 9, श्लोक 10 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: The serpent may, without being poisonous, raise high its hood, but the show of terror is enough to frighten people -- whether he be venomous or not.

verses.text: अध्याय 9, सूत्र 11
verses.hindi: अध्याय 9, श्लोक 11 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Wise men spend their mornings in discussing gambling, the afternoon discussing the activities of women, and the night hearing about the activities of theft. (The first item above refers to the gambling of King Yuddhisthira, the great devotee of Krishna. The second item refers to the glorious deeds of mother Sita, the consort of Lord Ramachandra. The third item hints at the adorable childhood pastimes of Sri Krishna who stole butter from the elderly cowherd ladies of Gokula. Hence Chanakya Pandits advises wise persons to spend the morning absorbed in Mahabharata, the afternoon studying Ramayana, and the evening devotedly hearing the Srimad-Bhagvatam.)

verses.text: अध्याय 9, सूत्र 12
verses.hindi: अध्याय 9, श्लोक 12 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: By preparing a garland for a Deity with one's own hand; by grinding sandal paste for the Lord with one's own hand; and by writing sacred texts with one's own hand -- one becomes blessed with opulence equal to that of Indra.

verses.text: अध्याय 9, सूत्र 13
verses.hindi: अध्याय 9, श्लोक 13 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Poverty is set off by fortitude; shabby garments by keeping them clean; bad food by warming it; and ugliness by good behaviour

verses.text: अध्याय 10, सूत्र 1
verses.hindi: अध्याय 10, श्लोक 1 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: One destitute of wealth is not destitute, he is indeed rich (if he is learned); but the man devoid of learning is destitute in every way.

verses.text: अध्याय 10, सूत्र 2
verses.hindi: अध्याय 10, श्लोक 2 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: We should carefully scrutinise that place upon which we step (having it ascertained to be free from filth and living creatures like insects, etc.); we should drink water which has been filtered (through a clean cloth); we should speak only those words which have the sanction of the satras; and do that act which we have carefully considered.

verses.text: अध्याय 10, सूत्र 3
verses.hindi: अध्याय 10, श्लोक 3 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: He who desires sense gratification must give up all thoughts of acquiring knowledge; and he who seeks knowledge must not hope for sense gratification. How can he who seeks sense gratification acquire knowledge, and he who possesses knowledge enjoy mundane sense pleasure?

verses.text: अध्याय 10, सूत्र 4
verses.hindi: अध्याय 10, श्लोक 4 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: What is it that escapes the observation of poets? What is that act women are incapable of doing? What will drunken people not prate? What will not a crow eat?

verses.text: अध्याय 10, सूत्र 5
verses.hindi: अध्याय 10, श्लोक 5 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Fate makes a beggar a king and a king a beggar. He makes a rich man poor and a poor man rich.

verses.text: अध्याय 10, सूत्र 6
verses.hindi: अध्याय 10, श्लोक 6 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: The beggar is a miser's enemy; the wise counsellor is the fool's enemy; her husband is an adulterous wife's enemy; and the moon is the enemy of the thief.

verses.text: अध्याय 10, सूत्र 7
verses.hindi: अध्याय 10, श्लोक 7 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Those who are destitute of learning, penance, knowledge, good disposition, virtue and benevolence are brutes wandering the earth in the form of men. They are burdensome to the earth.

verses.text: अध्याय 10, सूत्र 8
verses.hindi: अध्याय 10, श्लोक 8 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Those that are empty-minded cannot be benefited by instruction. Bamboo does not acquire the quality of sandalwood by being associated with the Malaya Mountain.

verses.text: अध्याय 10, सूत्र 9
verses.hindi: अध्याय 10, श्लोक 9 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: What good can the scriptures do to a man who has no sense of his own? Of what use is as mirror to a blind man?

verses.text: अध्याय 10, सूत्र 10
verses.hindi: अध्याय 10, श्लोक 10 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Nothing can reform a bad man, just as the posterious cannot become a superior part of the body though washed one hundred times.

verses.text: अध्याय 10, सूत्र 11
verses.hindi: अध्याय 10, श्लोक 11 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: By offending a kinsman, life is lost; by offending others, wealth is lost; by offending the king, everything is lost; and by offending a brahmana one's whole family is ruined.

verses.text: अध्याय 10, सूत्र 12
verses.hindi: अध्याय 10, श्लोक 12 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: It is better to live under a tree in a jungle inhabited by tigers and elephants, to maintain oneself in such a place with ripe fruits and spring water, to lie down on grass and to wear the ragged barks of trees than to live amongst one's relations when reduced to poverty.

verses.text: अध्याय 10, सूत्र 13
verses.hindi: अध्याय 10, श्लोक 13 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: The brahmana is like tree; his prayers are the roots, his chanting of the Vedas are the branches, and his religious act are the leaves. Consequently effort should be made to preserve his roots for if the roots are destroyed there can be no branches or leaves.

verses.text: अध्याय 10, सूत्र 14
verses.hindi: अध्याय 10, श्लोक 14 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: My mother is Kamala devi (Lakshmi), my father is Lord Janardana (Vishnu), my kinsmen are the Vishnu-bhaktas (Vaisnavas) and, my homeland is all the three worlds.

verses.text: अध्याय 10, सूत्र 15
verses.hindi: अध्याय 10, श्लोक 15 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: (Through the night) a great many kinds of birds perch(Sit and rest) on a tree but in the morning they fly in all the ten directions. Why should we lament (Expression of sorrow) for that? (Similarly, we should not grieve when we must inevitably part company from our dear ones).

verses.text: अध्याय 10, सूत्र 16
verses.hindi: अध्याय 10, श्लोक 16 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: He who possesses intelligence is strong; how can the man that is unintelligent be powerful? The elephant of the forest having lost his senses by intoxication was tricked into a lake by a small rabbit. (this verse refers to a famous story from the niti-sastra called pancatantra compiled by the pandit Vishnusharma 2500 years ago).

verses.text: अध्याय 10, सूत्र 17
verses.hindi: अध्याय 10, श्लोक 17 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Why should I be concerned for my maintenance while absorbed in praising the glories of Lord Vishwambhara (Vishnu), the supporter of all. Without the grace of Lord Hari, how could milk flow from a mother's breast for a child's nourishment? Repeatedly thinking only in this way, O Lord of the Yadus, O husband of Lakshmi, all my time is spent in serving Your lotus feet.

verses.text: अध्याय 11, सूत्र 1
verses.hindi: अध्याय 11, श्लोक 1 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Generosity, pleasing address, courage and propriety of conduct are not acquired, but are inbred qualities.

verses.text: अध्याय 11, सूत्र 2
verses.hindi: अध्याय 11, श्लोक 2 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: He who forsakes his own community and joins another perishes as the king who embraces an unrighteous path.

verses.text: अध्याय 11, सूत्र 3
verses.hindi: अध्याय 11, श्लोक 3 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: The elephant has a huge body but is controlled by the ankusha (goad): yet, is the goad as large as the elephant? A lighted candle banishes darkness: is the candle as vast as the darkness. A mountain is broken even by a thunderbolt: is the thunderbolt therefore as big as the mountain? No, he whose power prevails is really mighty; what is there in bulk?

verses.text: अध्याय 11, सूत्र 4
verses.hindi: अध्याय 11, श्लोक 4 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: He who is engrossed in family life will never acquire knowledge; there can be no mercy in the eater of flesh; the greedy man will not be truthful; and purity will not be found in a woman and a hunter.

verses.text: अध्याय 11, सूत्र 5
verses.hindi: अध्याय 11, श्लोक 5 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: The wicked man will not attain sanctity even if he is instructed in different ways, and the nim tree will not become sweet even if it is sprinkled from the top to the roots with milk and ghee.

verses.text: अध्याय 11, सूत्र 6
verses.hindi: अध्याय 11, श्लोक 6 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Mental dirt cannot be washed away even by one-hundred baths in the sacred waters, just as a wine pot cannot be purified even by evaporating all the wine by fire.

verses.text: अध्याय 11, सूत्र 7
verses.hindi: अध्याय 11, श्लोक 7 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: It is not strange if a man reviles (Degrades) a thing of which he has no knowledge, just as a wild hunter's wife throws away the pearl that is found in the head of an elephant, and picks up a gunj(a type of seed which poor tribals wear as ornaments).

verses.text: अध्याय 11, सूत्र 8
verses.hindi: अध्याय 11, श्लोक 8 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: He who for one year eats his meals silently (inwardly meditating upon the Lord's prasadam); attains to the heavenly planets for a thousand crore of years. ( Note: one crore equals ten million)

verses.text: अध्याय 11, सूत्र 9
verses.hindi: अध्याय 11, श्लोक 9 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: The student (brahmacari) should completely renounce the following eight things -- his lust, anger, greed, desire for sweets, sense of decorating the body, excessive curiosity, excessive sleep, and excessive endeavour for bodily maintenance.

verses.text: अध्याय 11, सूत्र 10
verses.hindi: अध्याय 11, श्लोक 10 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: He alone is a true brahmana (dvija or "twice-born") who is satisfied with one meal a day, who has the six samskaras (or acts of purification such as garbhadhana, etc.) performed for him, and who cohabits with his wife only once in a month on an auspicious day after her menses.

verses.text: अध्याय 11, सूत्र 11
verses.hindi: अध्याय 11, श्लोक 11 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: The brahmana who is engrossed in worldly affairs, brings up cows and is engaged in trade is really called a vaishya.

verses.text: अध्याय 11, सूत्र 12
verses.hindi: अध्याय 11, श्लोक 12 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: The brahmana who deals in lac-die, articles, oil, indigo, silken cloth, honey, clarified butter, liquor, and flesh is called a shudra.

verses.text: अध्याय 11, सूत्र 13
verses.hindi: अध्याय 11, श्लोक 13 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: The brahmana who thwarts the doings of others, who is hypocritical, selfish, and a deceitful hater, and while speaking mildly cherishes cruelty in his heart, is called a cat.

verses.text: अध्याय 11, सूत्र 14
verses.hindi: अध्याय 11, श्लोक 14 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: The brahmana who destroys a pond, a well, a tank, a garden and a temple is called a mleccha.

verses.text: अध्याय 11, सूत्र 15
verses.hindi: अध्याय 11, श्लोक 15 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: The brahmana who steals the property of the Deities and the spiritual preceptor, who cohabits with another's wife, and who maintains himself by eating anything and everything s called a chandala.

verses.text: अध्याय 11, सूत्र 16
verses.hindi: अध्याय 11, श्लोक 16 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: The meritorious should give away in charity all that they have in excess of their needs. By charity only Karna, Bali and King Vikramaditya survive even today. Just see the plight of the honeybees beating their legs in despair upon the earth. They are saying to themselves, 'Alas! We neither enjoyed our stored-up honey nor gave it in charity, and now someone has taken it from us in an instant.

verses.text: अध्याय 12, सूत्र 1
verses.hindi: अध्याय 12, श्लोक 1 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: He is a blessed grhasta (householder) in whose house there is a blissful atmosphere, whose sons are talented, whose wife speaks sweetly, whose wealth is enough to satisfy his desires, who finds pleasure in the company of his wife, whose servants are obedient, in whose house hospitality is shown, the auspicious Supreme Lord is worshiped daily, delicious food and drink is partaken, and who finds joy in the company of devotees.

verses.text: अध्याय 12, सूत्र 2
verses.hindi: अध्याय 12, श्लोक 2 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: One who devotedly gives a little to a brahmana who is in distress is recompensed abundantly. Hence, O Prince, what is given to a good brahmana is got back not in an equal quantity, but in an infinitely higher degree.

verses.text: अध्याय 12, सूत्र 3
verses.hindi: अध्याय 12, श्लोक 3 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Those men who are happy in this world, who are generous towards their relatives, kind to strangers, indifferent to the wicked, loving to the good, shrewd in their dealings with the base, frank with the learned, courageous with enemies, humble with elders and stern with the wife.

verses.text: अध्याय 12, सूत्र 4
verses.hindi: अध्याय 12, श्लोक 4 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: O jackal, leave aside the body of that man at once, whose hands have never given in charity, whose ears have not heard the voice of learning, whose eyes have not beheld a pure devotee of the Lord, whose feet have never traversed to holy places, whose belly is filled with things obtained by crooked practices, and whose head is held high in vanity. Do not eat it, O jackal, otherwise you will become polluted.

verses.text: अध्याय 12, सूत्र 5
verses.hindi: अध्याय 12, श्लोक 5 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: 'Shame upon those who have no devotion to the lotus feet of Sri Krishna, the son of mother Yasoda; who have no attachment for the describing the glories of Srimati Radharani; whose ears are not eager to listen to the stories of the Lord's lila.' Such is the exclamation of the mrdanga sound of dhik-tam dhik-tam dhigatam at kirtana.

verses.text: अध्याय 12, सूत्र 6
verses.hindi: अध्याय 12, श्लोक 6 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: What fault of spring that the bamboo shoot has no leaves? What fault of the sun if the owl cannot see during the daytime? Is it the fault of the clouds if no raindrops fall into the mouth of the chatak bird? Who can erase what Lord Brahma has inscribed upon our foreheads at the time of birth?

verses.text: अध्याय 12, सूत्र 7
verses.hindi: अध्याय 12, श्लोक 7 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: A wicked man may develop saintly qualities in the company of a devotee, but a devotee does not become impious in the company of a wicked person. The earth is scented by a flower that falls upon it, but the flower does not contact the odour of the earth.

verses.text: अध्याय 12, सूत्र 8
verses.hindi: अध्याय 12, श्लोक 8 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: One indeed becomes blessed by having darshan of a devotee; for the devotee has the ability to purify immediately, whereas the sacred tirtha gives purity only after prolonged contact.

verses.text: अध्याय 12, सूत्र 9
verses.hindi: अध्याय 12, श्लोक 9 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: A stranger asked a brahmana, 'Tell me, who is great in this city?' The brahmana replied, 'The cluster of palmyra trees is great.' Then the traveller asked, 'Who is the most charitable person?' The brahmana answered, 'The washerman who takes the clothes in the morning and gives them back in the evening is the most charitable.' He then asked, 'Who is the ablest man?' The brahmana answered, 'Everyone is expert in robbing others of their wives and wealth.' The man then asked the brahmana, 'How do you manage to live in such a city?' The brahmana replied, 'As a worm survives while even in a filthy place so do I survive here!'

verses.text: अध्याय 12, सूत्र 10
verses.hindi: अध्याय 12, श्लोक 10 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: The house in which the lotus feet of brahmanas are not washed, in which Vedic mantras are not loudly recited, and in which the holy rites of svaha (sacrificial offerings to the Supreme Lord) and swadha (offerings to the ancestors) are not performed, is like a crematorium.

verses.text: अध्याय 12, सूत्र 11
verses.hindi: अध्याय 12, श्लोक 11 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: (It is said that a sadhu, when asked about his family, replied thusly): truth is my mother, and my father is spiritual knowledge; righteous conduct is my brother, and mercy is my friend, inner peace is my wife, and forgiveness is my son: these six are my kinsmen.

verses.text: अध्याय 12, सूत्र 12
verses.hindi: अध्याय 12, श्लोक 12 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Our bodies are perishable, wealth is not at all permanent and death is always nearby. Therefore we must immediately engage in acts of merit.

verses.text: अध्याय 12, सूत्र 13
verses.hindi: अध्याय 12, श्लोक 13 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Arjuna says to Krishna. 'Brahmanas find joy in going to feasts, cows find joy in eating their tender grass, wives find joy in the company of their husbands, and know, O Krishna, that in the same way I rejoice in battle.

verses.text: अध्याय 12, सूत्र 14
verses.hindi: अध्याय 12, श्लोक 14 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: He who regards another's wife as his mother, the wealth that does not belong to him as a lump of mud, and the pleasure and pain of all other living beings as his own -- truly sees things in the right perspective, and he is a true pandit.

verses.text: अध्याय 12, सूत्र 15
verses.hindi: अध्याय 12, श्लोक 15 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: O Raghava, the love of virtue, pleasing speech, and an ardent desire for performing acts of charity, guileless dealings with friends, humility in the guru's presence , deep tranquillity of mind, pure conduct, discernment of virtues, realised knowledge of the sastras, beauty of form and devotion to God are all found in you.' (The great sage Vasistha Muni, the spiritual preceptor of the dynasty of the sun, said this to Lord Ramachandra at the time of His proposed coronation).

verses.text: अध्याय 12, सूत्र 16
verses.hindi: अध्याय 12, श्लोक 16 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: The desire tree is wood; the golden Mount Meru is motionless; the wish-fulfilling gem cintamani is just a stone; the sun is scorching; the moon is prone to wane; the boundless ocean is saline; the demigod of lust lost his body (due to Shiva's wrath); Bali Maharaja, the son of Diti, was born into a clan of demons; and Kamadhenu (the cow of heaven) is a mere beast. O Lord of the Raghu dynasty! I cannot compare you to any one of these (taking their merits into account).

verses.text: अध्याय 12, सूत्र 17
verses.hindi: अध्याय 12, श्लोक 17 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Realised learning (vidya) is our friend while travelling , the wife is a friend at home, medicine is the friend of a sick man, and meritorious deeds are the friends at death.

verses.text: अध्याय 12, सूत्र 18
verses.hindi: अध्याय 12, श्लोक 18 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Courtesy should be learned from princes, the art of conversation from pandits, lying should be learned from gamblers and deceitful ways should be learned from women.

verses.text: अध्याय 12, सूत्र 19
verses.hindi: अध्याय 12, श्लोक 19 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: The unthinking spender, the homeless urchin (|e@p`|ob#), the quarrel monger (x#[@o@]#), the man who neglects his wife and is heedless in his actions -- all these will soon come to ruination.

verses.text: अध्याय 12, सूत्र 20
verses.hindi: अध्याय 12, श्लोक 20 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: The wise man should not be anxious about his food; he should be anxious to be engaged only in dharma (Krishna consciousness). the food of each man is created for him at his birth.

verses.text: अध्याय 12, सूत्र 21
verses.hindi: अध्याय 12, श्लोक 21 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: He who is not shy in the acquisition of wealth, grain and knowledge, and in taking his meals, will be happy

verses.text: अध्याय 12, सूत्र 22
verses.hindi: अध्याय 12, श्लोक 22 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: As centesimal droppings will fill a pot so also are knowledge, virtue and wealth gradually obtained.

verses.text: अध्याय 12, सूत्र 23
verses.hindi: अध्याय 12, श्लोक 23 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: The man who remains a fool even in advanced age is really a fool, just as the Indra-Varuna fruit does not become sweet no matter how ripe it might becom

verses.text: अध्याय 13, सूत्र 1
verses.hindi: अध्याय 13, श्लोक 1 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english:
A man may live but for a moment, but that moment should be spent in doing auspicious deeds. It is useless living even for a kalpa (4,320,000
*1000 years) and bringing only distress upon the two worlds (this world and the next).

verses.text: अध्याय 13, सूत्र 2
verses.hindi: अध्याय 13, श्लोक 2 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: We should not fret for what is past, nor should we be anxious about the future; men of discernment deal only with the present moment.

verses.text: अध्याय 13, सूत्र 3
verses.hindi: अध्याय 13, श्लोक 3 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english:
It certainly is nature of the demigods, men of good character, and parents to be easily pleased. Near and distant relatives are pleased when
they are hospitably received with bathing, food, and drink; and pandits are pleased with an opportunity for giving spiritual discourse.

verses.text: अध्याय 13, सूत्र 4
verses.hindi: अध्याय 13, श्लोक 4 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Even as the unborn babe is in the womb of his mother, these five are fixed as his life destiny: his life span, his activities, his acquisition of wealth and knowledge, and his time of death.

verses.text: अध्याय 13, सूत्र 5
verses.hindi: अध्याय 13, श्लोक 5 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: O see what a wonder it is! The doings of the great are strange: they treat wealth as light as a straw, yet, when they obtain it, they bend under its weight.

verses.text: अध्याय 13, सूत्र 6
verses.hindi: अध्याय 13, श्लोक 6 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english:
He who is overly attached to his family members experiences fear and sorrow, for the root of all grief is attachment. Thus one should discard
attachment to be happy.

verses.text: अध्याय 13, सूत्र 7
verses.hindi: अध्याय 13, श्लोक 7 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english:
He who is prepared for the future and he who deals cleverly with any situation that may arise are both happy; but the fatalistic man who
wholly depends on luck is ruined.

verses.text: अध्याय 13, सूत्र 8
verses.hindi: अध्याय 13, श्लोक 8 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: If the king is virtuous, then the subjects are also virtuous. If the king is sinful, then the subjects also become sinful. If he is mediocre, then the subjects are mediocre. The subjects follow the example of the king. In short, as is the king so are the subjects.

verses.text: अध्याय 13, सूत्र 9
verses.hindi: अध्याय 13, श्लोक 9 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english:
I consider him who does not act religiously as dead though living, but he who dies acting religiously unquestionably lives long though he is
dead.

verses.text: अध्याय 13, सूत्र 10
verses.hindi: अध्याय 13, श्लोक 10 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: He who has acquired neither virtue, wealth, satisfaction of desires nor salvation (dharma, artha, kama, moksa), lives an utterly useless life, like the 'nipples' hanging from the neck of a goat.

verses.text: अध्याय 13, सूत्र 11
verses.hindi: अध्याय 13, श्लोक 11 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: The hearts of base men burn before the fire of other's fame, and they slander them being themselves unable to rise to such a high position.

verses.text: अध्याय 13, सूत्र 12
verses.hindi: अध्याय 13, श्लोक 12 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Excessive attachment to sense pleasures leads to bondage, and detachment from sense pleasures leads to liberation; therefore it is the mind alone that is responsible for bondage or liberation.

verses.text: अध्याय 13, सूत्र 13
verses.hindi: अध्याय 13, श्लोक 13 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: He who sheds bodily identification by means of knowledge of the indwelling Supreme Self (Paramatma), will always be absorbed in meditative trance (samadhi) wherever his mind leads him.

verses.text: अध्याय 13, सूत्र 14
verses.hindi: अध्याय 13, श्लोक 14 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Who realises all the happiness he desires? Everything is in the hands of God. Therefore one should learn contentment.

verses.text: अध्याय 13, सूत्र 15
verses.hindi: अध्याय 13, श्लोक 15 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: As a calf follows its mother among a thousand cows, so the (good or bad) deeds of a man follow him.

verses.text: अध्याय 13, सूत्र 16
verses.hindi: अध्याय 13, श्लोक 16 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: He whose actions are disorganised has no happiness either in the midst of men or in a jungle -- in the midst of men his heart burns by social contacts, and his helplessness burns him in the forest.

verses.text: अध्याय 13, सूत्र 17
verses.hindi: अध्याय 13, श्लोक 17 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: As the man who digs obtains underground water by use of a shovel, so the student attains the knowledge possessed by his preceptor through his service.

verses.text: अध्याय 13, सूत्र 18
verses.hindi: अध्याय 13, श्लोक 18 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Men reap the fruits of their deeds, and intellects bear the mark of deeds performed in previous lives; even so the wise act after due circumspection.

verses.text: अध्याय 13, सूत्र 19
verses.hindi: अध्याय 13, श्लोक 19 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Even the man who has taught the spiritual significance of just one letter ought to be worshiped. He who does not give reverence to such a guru is born as a dog a hundred times, and at last takes birth as a chandala (dog-eater).

verses.text: अध्याय 13, सूत्र 20
verses.hindi: अध्याय 13, श्लोक 20 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: At the end of the yuga, Mount Meru may be shaken; at the end of the kalpa, the waters of the seven oceans may be disturbed; but a sadhu will never swerve from the spiritual path.

verses.text: अध्याय 13, सूत्र 21
verses.hindi: अध्याय 13, श्लोक 21 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: There are three gems upon this earth; food, water, and pleasing words -- fools (mudhas) consider pieces of rocks as gems.

verses.text: अध्याय 14, सूत्र 1
verses.hindi: अध्याय 14, श्लोक 1 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Poverty, disease, sorrow, imprisonment and other evils are the fruits borne by the tree of one's own sins.

verses.text: अध्याय 14, सूत्र 2
verses.hindi: अध्याय 14, श्लोक 2 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Wealth, a friend, a wife, and a kingdom may be regained; but this body when lost may never be acquired again.

verses.text: अध्याय 14, सूत्र 3
verses.hindi: अध्याय 14, श्लोक 3 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: The enemy can be overcome by the union of large numbers, just as grass through its collectiveness wards off erosion caused by heavy rainfall.

verses.text: अध्याय 14, सूत्र 4
verses.hindi: अध्याय 14, श्लोक 4 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Oil on water, a secret communicated to a base man, a gift given to a worthy receiver, and scriptural instruction given to an intelligent man spread out by virtue of their nature.

verses.text: अध्याय 14, सूत्र 5
verses.hindi: अध्याय 14, श्लोक 5 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: If men should always retain the state of mind they experience when hearing religious instruction, when present at a crematorium ground, and when in sickness -- then who could not attain liberation.

verses.text: अध्याय 14, सूत्र 6
verses.hindi: अध्याय 14, श्लोक 6 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: If a man should feel before, as he feels after, repentance -- then who would not attain perfection?

verses.text: अध्याय 14, सूत्र 7
verses.hindi: अध्याय 14, श्लोक 7 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: We should not feel pride in our charity, austerity, valour, scriptural knowledge, modesty and morality for the world is full of the rarest gems.

verses.text: अध्याय 14, सूत्र 8
verses.hindi: अध्याय 14, श्लोक 8 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: He who lives in our mind is near though he may actually be far away; but he who is not in our heart is far though he may really be nearby.

verses.text: अध्याय 14, सूत्र 9
verses.hindi: अध्याय 14, श्लोक 9 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: We should always speak what would please the man of whom we expect a favour, like the hunter who sings sweetly when he desires to shoot a deer.

verses.text: अध्याय 14, सूत्र 10
verses.hindi: अध्याय 14, श्लोक 10 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: It is ruinous to be familiar with the king, fire, the religious preceptor, and a woman. To be altogether indifferent of them is to be deprived of the opportunity to benefit ourselves, hence our association with them must be from a safe distance.

verses.text: अध्याय 14, सूत्र 11
verses.hindi: अध्याय 14, श्लोक 11 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: We should always deal cautiously with fire, water, women, foolish people, serpents, and members of a royal family; for they may, when the occasion presents itself, at once bring about our death.

verses.text: अध्याय 14, सूत्र 12
verses.hindi: अध्याय 14, श्लोक 12 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: He should be considered to be living who is virtuous and pious, but the life of a man who is destitute of religion and virtues is void of any blessing.

verses.text: अध्याय 14, सूत्र 13
verses.hindi: अध्याय 14, श्लोक 13 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: If you wish to gain control of the world by the performance of a single deed, then keep the following fifteen, which are prone to wander here and there, from getting the upper hand of you: the five sense objects (objects of sight, sound, smell, taste, and touch); the five sense organs (ears, eyes, nose, tongue and skin) and organs of activity (hands, legs, mouth, genitals and anus).

verses.text: अध्याय 14, सूत्र 14
verses.hindi: अध्याय 14, श्लोक 14 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: He is a pandit (man of knowledge) who speaks what is suitable to the occasion, who renders loving service according to his ability, and who knows the limits of his anger.

verses.text: अध्याय 14, सूत्र 16
verses.hindi: अध्याय 14, श्लोक 16 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: A wise man should not divulge the formula of a medicine which he has well prepared; an act of charity which he has performed; domestic conflicts; private affairs with his wife; poorly prepared food he may have been offered; or slang he may have heard.

verses.text: अध्याय 14, सूत्र 17
verses.hindi: अध्याय 14, श्लोक 17 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: The cuckoos remain silent for a long time (for several seasons) until they are able to sing sweetly (in the Spring ) so as to give joy to all.

verses.text: अध्याय 14, सूत्र 18
verses.hindi: अध्याय 14, श्लोक 18 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: We should secure and keep the following: the blessings of meritorious deeds, wealth, grain, the words of the spiritual master, and rare medicines. Otherwise life becomes impossible.

verses.text: अध्याय 14, सूत्र 19
verses.hindi: अध्याय 14, श्लोक 19 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Eschew (Avoid) wicked company and associate with saintly persons. Acquire virtue day and night, and always meditate on that which is eternal forgetting that which is temporary

verses.text: अध्याय 15, सूत्र 1
verses.hindi: अध्याय 15, श्लोक 1 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: For one whose heart melts with compassion for all creatures; what is the necessity of knowledge, liberation, matted hair on the head, and smearing the body with ashes.

verses.text: अध्याय 15, सूत्र 2
verses.hindi: अध्याय 15, श्लोक 2 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: There is no treasure on earth the gift of which will cancel the debt a disciple owes his guru for having taught him even a single letter ( that leads to Krishna consciousness).

verses.text: अध्याय 15, सूत्र 3
verses.hindi: अध्याय 15, श्लोक 3 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: There are two ways to get rid of thorns and wicked persons; using footwear in the first case and in the second shaming them so that they cannot raise their faces again thus keeping them at a distance.

verses.text: अध्याय 15, सूत्र 4
verses.hindi: अध्याय 15, श्लोक 4 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: He who wears unclean garments, has dirty teeth, as a glutton, speaks unkindly and sleeps after sunrise -- although he may be the greatest personality -- will lose the favour of Lakshmi.

verses.text: अध्याय 15, सूत्र 5
verses.hindi: अध्याय 15, श्लोक 5 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: He who loses his money is forsaken by his friends, his wife, his servants and his relations; yet when he regains his riches those who have forsaken him come back to him. Hence wealth is certainly the best of relations.

verses.text: अध्याय 15, सूत्र 6
verses.hindi: अध्याय 15, श्लोक 6 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Sinfully acquired wealth may remain for ten years; in the eleventh year it disappears with even the original stock.

verses.text: अध्याय 15, सूत्र 7
verses.hindi: अध्याय 15, श्लोक 7 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: A bad action committed by a great man is not censured (as there is none that can reproach him), and a good action performed by a low-class man comes to be condemned (because none respects him). Just see: the drinking of nectar is excellent, but it became the cause of Rahu's demise; and the drinking of poison is harmful, but when Lord Shiva (who is exalted) drank it, it became an ornament to his neck (nilakanta).

verses.text: अध्याय 15, सूत्र 8
verses.hindi: अध्याय 15, श्लोक 8 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: A true meal is that which consists of the remnants left after a brahmana's meal. Love which is shown to others is true love, not that which is cherished for one's own self. to abstain from sin is true wisdom. That is an act of charity which is performed without ostentation.

verses.text: अध्याय 15, सूत्र 9
verses.hindi: अध्याय 15, श्लोक 9 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: For want of discernment the most precious jewels lie in the dust at the feet of men while bits of glass are worn on their heads. But we should not imagine that the gems have sunk in value, and the bits of glass have risen in importance. When a person of critical judgement shall appear, each will be given its right position.

verses.text: अध्याय 15, सूत्र 10
verses.hindi: अध्याय 15, श्लोक 10 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Sastric knowledge is unlimited, and the arts to be learned are many; the time we have is short, and our opportunities to learn are beset with obstacles. Therefore select for learning that which is most important, just as the swan drinks only the milk in water.

verses.text: अध्याय 15, सूत्र 11
verses.hindi: अध्याय 15, श्लोक 11 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: He is a chandala who eats his dinner without entertaining the stranger who has come to his house quite accidentally, having travelled from a long distance and is wearied.

verses.text: अध्याय 15, सूत्र 12
verses.hindi: अध्याय 15, श्लोक 12 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: One may know the four Vedas and the Dharma-sastras, yet if he has no realisation of his own spiritual self, he can be said to be like the ladle which stirs all kinds of foods but knows not the taste of any.

verses.text: अध्याय 15, सूत्र 13
verses.hindi: अध्याय 15, श्लोक 13 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Those blessed souls are certainly elevated who, while crossing the ocean of life, take shelter of a genuine brahmana, who is likened unto a boat. They are unlike passengers aboard an ordinary ship which runs the risk of sinking.

verses.text: अध्याय 15, सूत्र 14
verses.hindi: अध्याय 15, श्लोक 14 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: The moon, who is the abode of nectar and the presiding deity of all medicines, although immortal like amrta and resplendent in form, loses the brilliance of his rays when he repairs to the abode of the sun (day time). Therefore will not an ordinary man be made to feel inferior by going to live at the house of another.

verses.text: अध्याय 15, सूत्र 15
verses.hindi: अध्याय 15, श्लोक 15 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: This humble bee, who always resides among the soft petals of the lotus and drinks abundantly its sweet nectar, is now feasting on the flower of the ordinary kutaja. Being in a strange country where the lotuses do not exist, he is considering the pollen of the kutaja to be nice.

verses.text: अध्याय 15, सूत्र 16
verses.hindi: अध्याय 15, श्लोक 16 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: (Lord Visnu asked His spouse Lakshmi why She did not care to live in the house of a brahmana, when She replied) ' O Lord a rishi named Agastya drank up My father (the ocean) in anger; Brighu Muni kicked You; brahmanas pride themselves on their learning having sought the favour of My competitor Sarasvati; and lastly they pluck each day the lotus which is My abode, and therewith worship Lord Shiva. Therefore, O Lord, I fear to dwell with a brahmana and that properly.

verses.text: अध्याय 15, सूत्र 17
verses.hindi: अध्याय 15, श्लोक 17 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: There are many ways of binding by which one can be dominated and controlled in this world, but the bond of affection is the strongest. For example, take the case of the humble bee which, although expert at piercing hardened wood, becomes caught in the embrace of its beloved flowers (as the petals close at dusk).

verses.text: अध्याय 15, सूत्र 18
verses.hindi: अध्याय 15, श्लोक 18 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Although sandalwood be cut, it does not forsake its natural quality of fragrance; so also the elephant does not give up sportiveness though he should grow old. The sugarcane does not cease to be sweet though squeezed in a mill; so the man of noble extraction does not lose his lofty qualities, no matter how pinched he is by poverty.

verses.text: अध्याय 16, सूत्र 1
verses.hindi: अध्याय 16, श्लोक 1 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: The heart of a woman is not united; it is divided. While she is talking with one man, she looks lustfully at another and thinks fondly of a third in her heart.

verses.text: अध्याय 16, सूत्र 2
verses.hindi: अध्याय 16, श्लोक 2 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: The fool (mudha) who fancies that a charming young lady loves him, becomes her slave and he dances like a shakuntal bird tied to a string.

verses.text: अध्याय 16, सूत्र 3
verses.hindi: अध्याय 16, श्लोक 3 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Who is there who, having become rich, has not become proud? Which licentious (Free) man has put an end to his calamities (A grievous disaster)? Which man in this world has not been overcome by a woman? Who is always loved by the king? Who is there who has not been overcome by the ravages of time? Which beggar has attained glory? Who has become happy by contracting the vices of the wicked?

verses.text: अध्याय 16, सूत्र 4
verses.hindi: अध्याय 16, श्लोक 4 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: A man attains greatness by his merits, not simply by occupying an exalted seat. Can we call a crow an eagle (garuda) simply because he sits on the top of a tall building.

verses.text: अध्याय 16, सूत्र 5
verses.hindi: अध्याय 16, श्लोक 5 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: The man who is praised by others as great is regarded as worthy though he may be really void of all merit. But the man who sings his own praises lowers himself in the estimation of others though he should be Indra (the possessor of all excellences).

verses.text: अध्याय 16, सूत्र 6
verses.hindi: अध्याय 16, श्लोक 6 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: If good qualities should characterise a man of discrimination, the brilliance of his qualities will be recognised just as a gem which is essentially bright really shines when fixed in an ornament of gold.

verses.text: अध्याय 16, सूत्र 7
verses.hindi: अध्याय 16, श्लोक 7 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Even one who by his qualities appears to be all knowing suffers without patronage; the gem, though precious, requires a gold setting.

verses.text: अध्याय 16, सूत्र 8
verses.hindi: अध्याय 16, श्लोक 8 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: I do not deserve that wealth which is to be attained by enduring much suffering, or by transgressing the rules of virtue, or by flattering an enemy.

verses.text: अध्याय 16, सूत्र 9
verses.hindi: अध्याय 16, श्लोक 9 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Those who were not satiated with the enjoyment of wealth, food and women have all passed away; there are others now passing away who have likewise remained unsatiated; and in the future still others will pass away feeling themselves unsatiated.

verses.text: अध्याय 16, सूत्र 10
verses.hindi: अध्याय 16, श्लोक 10 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: All charities and sacrifices (performed for fruitive gain) bring only temporary results, but gifts made to deserving persons (those who are Krishna consciousness) and protection offered to all creatures shall never perish.

verses.text: अध्याय 16, सूत्र 11
verses.hindi: अध्याय 16, श्लोक 11 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: A blade of grass is light, cotton is lighter, the beggar is infinitely lighter still. Why then does not the wind carry him away? Because it fears that he may ask alms of him.

verses.text: अध्याय 16, सूत्र 12
verses.hindi: अध्याय 16, श्लोक 12 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: It is better to die than to preserve this life by incurring disgrace. The loss of life causes but a moment's grief, but disgrace brings grief every day of one's life.

verses.text: अध्याय 16, सूत्र 13
verses.hindi: अध्याय 16, श्लोक 13 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: All the creatures are pleased by loving words; and therefore we should address words that are pleasing to all, for there is no lack of sweet words.

verses.text: अध्याय 16, सूत्र 14
verses.hindi: अध्याय 16, श्लोक 14 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: There are two nectarean fruits hanging from the tree of this world: one is the hearing of sweet words (such as Krishna-katha) and the other, the society of saintly men.

verses.text: अध्याय 16, सूत्र 15
verses.hindi: अध्याय 16, श्लोक 15 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: The good habits of charity, learning and austerity practised during many past lives continue to be cultivated in this birth by virtue of the link (yoga) of this present life to the previous ones.

verses.text: अध्याय 16, सूत्र 16
verses.hindi: अध्याय 16, श्लोक 16 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: One whose knowledge is confined to books and whose wealth is in the possession of others, can use neither his knowledge nor wealth when the need for them arise

verses.text: अध्याय 17, सूत्र 1
verses.hindi: अध्याय 17, श्लोक 1 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: The scholar who has acquired knowledge by studying innumerable books without the blessings of a bonafide spiritual master does not shine in an assembly of truly learned men just as an illegitimate child is not honoured in society.

verses.text: अध्याय 17, सूत्र 2
verses.hindi: अध्याय 17, श्लोक 2 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: We should repay the favours of others by acts of kindness; so also should we return evil for evil in which there is no sin, for it is necessary to pay a wicked man in his own coin.

verses.text: अध्याय 17, सूत्र 3
verses.hindi: अध्याय 17, श्लोक 3 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: That thing which is distant, that thing which appears impossible, and that which is far beyond our reach, can be easily attained through tapasya (religious austerity), for nothing can surpass austerity.

verses.text: अध्याय 17, सूत्र 4
verses.hindi: अध्याय 17, श्लोक 4 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: What vice could be worse than covetousness? What is more sinful than slander? For one who is truthful, what need is there for austerity? For one who has a clean heart, what is the need for pilgrimage? If one has a good disposition, what other virtue is needed? If a man has fame, what is the value of other ornamentation? What need is there for wealth for the man of practical knowledge? And if a man is dishonoured, what could there be worse in death?

verses.text: अध्याय 17, सूत्र 5
verses.hindi: अध्याय 17, श्लोक 5 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: Though the sea, which is the reservoir of all jewels, is the father of the conch shell, and the Goddess of fortune Lakshmi is conch's sister, still the conch must go from door to door for alms (in the hands of a beggar). It is true, therefore, that one gains nothing without having given in the past.

verses.text: अध्याय 17, सूत्र 6
verses.hindi: अध्याय 17, श्लोक 6 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
verses.english: When a man has no strength left in him he becomes a sadhu, one without wealth acts like a brahmacari, a sick man behaves like a devotee of the Lord, and when a woman grows old she becomes devoted to her husband.

verses.text: अध्याय 17, सूत्र 7
verses.hindi: अध्याय 17, श्लोक 7 का नीति सूत्र एवं जीवन प्रबंधन।
